title: Dental PPO Plans Rollover of Unused Annual Maximum
content:
**Which plans.** Only Dental PPO Plans with rollover offered bank rollover dollars.

**Earning a credit.** At the end of each benefit period a person qualifies for a credit when all of the following hold:
- the enrollment was continuously active for at least the plan's minimum months enrolled of that benefit period;
- it is still active on the first day of the next benefit period;
- the plan payments posted to the annual maximum for the ending benefit period are greater than 0.00 and no more than the plan's claims threshold.

**Amount of the credit.** The plan's credit amount, reduced so that the rollover balance after the credit does not exceed the plan's rollover balance cap (never below 0.00). It is posted on the first day of the next benefit period with the ending benefit year.

**Using rollover dollars.** Rollover dollars are used only after the annual maximum for the benefit period is exhausted: the part of a line's normal benefit above the remaining annual maximum is paid from the rollover balance up to that balance, the line carries the paid-from-rollover remark, and the rollover part is drawn from the rollover balance instead of posted to the annual maximum.

**Forfeiture and carry-over.** The rollover balance is forfeited when the enrollment terminates or is cancelled, or when the plan is changed to a plan without rollover; it is carried unchanged across a change between rollover plans and across a reinstatement without a gap.

### Worked credit (hypothetical plan: threshold 600.00, credit 300.00, cap 800.00)
A person with 410.00 posted to the maximum and a balance of 650.00 qualifies; the credit is the lesser of 300.00 and 800.00 less 650.00, which is 150.00.
